notes: Known-ledger rows for this chunk (acdsl-policy-guard untested, nightly gating untested, sync_settings marker test, sync_hooks EOF guard, bootstrap dry-run-only/roster, squashed:2 count, vacuous steady-state test, .serena husk, .DS_Store any depth, remote-FROM squash clause, worktree.sh symbolic-ref clause, sync_skills operator-key merge, skill-invoke-gate string-content branch) were not re-reported. Spec-named tests checked: spec-5 test_sync_skills_overrides.sh (casual off+overlay on, developer drop, foreign keys) present; spec-5 test_routine_worktree.sh prune case present (test_reset_after_merge); spec-8 casual fixture + non-developer migration present; spec-9 test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh five cases present; spec-11 squash/edited-squash and remove squash cases present (count gap is known); spec-13 explicitly leaves install.sh untested. findings.fix: Add a test_print_agent_worktrees_status.sh case where main holds a same-subject commit with different content plus a later squash of the branch, and assert the `unpicked <hash>` drill-down prints 'content contained in main via squash' instead of 'twin ... differs'.
findings.claim: The new squash annotation in the detail-mode `unpicked` arm (twin exists but range-diff rejected it, yet a candidate squash-contains the branch) is never exercised: every squash fixture lands under a different subject, so only the `unpicked-notwin` arm's squash branch runs.
findings.evidence: Re-read print_agent_worktrees_status.sh:198-206 (unpicked arm, new `if [ -n "$squash_in" ]`) and every detail-mode call in test_print_agent_worktrees_status.sh: test_squash_transfer_reads_contained (L469-499) uses subjects 'agent step one/two' vs main 'squash-landed agent work' -> no exact-subject twin -> unpicked-notwin arm; test_edited_squash_stays_unpicked (L504-531) has no detail call and its merge-tree conflicts (squash_in empty); test_reworded_twin_stays_unpicked (L432-461) and test_resolved_and_negative_verdicts conflict in merge-tree, so squash_in is empty there. Input that reaches the untested line: agent commit 'X' (content v1), main commit 'X' (content v2, range-diff unpaired) followed by a squash of the full branch content onto main. Only the annotation text depends on it (UNPICKED/IN are computed by evaluate_branch), hence cosmetic.

findings.fix: Scrub the wrapper's env inputs in run_wrapper: `env -u SMINE_DEV_MODE -u BOOTSTRAP_SINCE -u BOOTSTRAP_N -u BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT -u SMINE_AGENTS HOME="$fake_home" BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN=1 bash ...` and pass the per-case overrides explicitly.
findings.claim: run_wrapper fakes only HOME and BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN, so the wrapper reads the developer's ambient SMINE_DEV_MODE / BOOTSTRAP_SINCE / BOOTSTRAP_N: running the suite from a shell with SMINE_DEV_MODE=1 exported makes the 'defaults' case fail ('unexpected --dev'), and an exported BOOTSTRAP_SINCE fails the '--last 30' assertion.
findings.evidence: Re-read test_bootstrap_wrapper.sh:39-47 (run_wrapper sets HOME and BOOTSTRAP_DRY_RUN only; defaults case asserts no --dev and --last 30) against cmd/bootstrap/run.sh:64-65 (dev_mode=${SMINE_DEV_MODE:-}, profile only fills when empty) and 88-96 (since=${BOOTSTRAP_SINCE:-} replaces --last). Sequence: `export SMINE_DEV_MODE=1; make test` -> run.sh L97 appends --dev -> test L47 `grep -q -- '--dev' && fail` exits 1. Only developers running the suite feel it -> debt; requires a non-default exported env -> rare.
